items.title: Show configured gitRoot status in non-git session brief
items.context: If metadataRoot itself is non-git but config.gitRoot points to a valid child repo, session_brief should render that distinction: metadata root non-git, configured gitRoot present, signed workspace resolvable. It must not imply branch/worktree phases are impossible when configured-git-root resolution is available.
items.userSees: Terminal includes quoted lines: "Signed workspace: OK", "configured gitRoot: clawcreek", and "resolutionSource: configured-git-root" for a configured wrapper-root project.

happy.desc: metadataRoot is non-git and config.gitRoot points to a valid child repo; session_brief output includes configured gitRoot, signed workspace OK, signedWorkspaceRoot path, and resolutionSource configured-git-root

edge.desc: normal git-backed project session_brief output does not render the configured-gitRoot wrapper-root block

adversarial.desc: configured gitRoot is invalid or missing; session_brief does not claim signed workspace OK

verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts configured wrapper-root session_brief includes Signed workspace: OK, configured gitRoot: clawcreek, signedWorkspaceRoot path, and resolutionSource: configured-git-root.
Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts a normal git-backed project does not render the wrapper-root configured gitRoot signed workspace block.
Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts missing configured gitRoot renders unresolved status and never claims Signed workspace: OK.

items.title: Keep fail-closed behavior for unresolved wrapper roots
items.context: Projects with metadataRoot non-git and no valid gitRoot should keep the existing warning/failure behavior. This fix is presentation/diagnostic correctness only; it must not make session_brief guess a child repo or mutate config.
items.userSees: Terminal still includes quoted guidance like "Non-git project" or "signed workspace unresolved" and does not include "Signed workspace: OK" when no valid configured gitRoot exists.

happy.desc: metadataRoot is non-git with no configured gitRoot; session_brief keeps Non-git project guidance and no signed workspace OK claim

edge.desc: metadataRoot is non-git with configured gitRoot outside/missing/not git; session_brief reports configured gitRoot unresolved or invalid without claiming OK

adversarial.desc: wrapper root has a single child git repo but no configured gitRoot; session_brief does not guess the child repo or mutate config

verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts an unconfigured non-git wrapper root keeps Non-git project guidance and does not include Signed workspace: OK.
Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts configured gitRoot=missing-creek renders signed workspace unresolved with configured_gitRoot_missing and no OK claim.
Build passed and field-regression smoke asserts a wrapper root with a child git repo but no configured gitRoot does not guess the child repo and does not mutate config.

items.title: Operator sees configured and unresolved wrapper-root states clearly
items.context: Add CLI regression coverage using wrapper-root fixtures so the product-visible session_brief result is stable: configured gitRoot projects show configured-git-root / signed workspace OK, while unresolved wrapper roots still show non-git or unresolved guidance without guessing or mutating config.
items.userSees: Regression output remains stable: configured fixture asserts "Signed workspace: OK" and unresolved fixture asserts absence of "Signed workspace: OK".

happy.desc: field-regression smoke asserts configured wrapper-root session_brief contains configured gitRoot and signed workspace OK output

edge.desc: field-regression smoke asserts unresolved wrapper-root session_brief still contains non-git/unresolved guidance and no OK claim

adversarial.desc: field-regression smoke asserts session_brief output does not mutate config while rendering wrapper-root state
